verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 109.7 (-1.1% in a day) and momentum is 41: prices are falling. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,000 and 86s 4,700. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-07T17:21:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Cristiano Ronaldo 89 Ultimate Scream after its 22% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 4,515,000 coins. Now 4,550,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 21.6% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 5 of 10 so far, averaging +6.5% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Nico Paz 87 Destined for Glory after its 31% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 200,000 coins. Now 182,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 30.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 6 so far, averaging -1.7% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,700 (1.15 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,000 (1.09 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,500 (1.51 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Gonzalo and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Gonzalo 75 Rare -56.1%; Klara Bühl 89 Team of the week -35.6%; Michael Olise 90 Rare -27.1%; Georgia Stanway 87 Team of the week -26.9%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Jonny SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 44.6K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
